findings.description: Return value of external ISkyPSM(psm).buyGem(batchMinter, gemAmt) is ignored. buyGem on a Sky/Maker PSM returns the amount of USDS pulled; ignoring it means a partial-fill or interface drift goes undetected. Corroborated by Aderyn 'Unchecked Return'.

Return value of IERC4626(_sUSDS).deposit(poolingUSDS, address(this)) is ignored — the minted sUSDS shares are not captured and the call is not checked for short-deposit. Accounting relies on a separate balance read; flag for review against the fee-on-transfer/balance-before-after design. Corroborated by Aderyn.
Return value of IBalancerVault(_vault).unlock(data) is ignored. Balancer unlock returns the decoded callback result; typically safe to ignore but unchecked. Corroborated by Aderyn.
Return value of IBalancerVault(_vault).settle(IERC20(_sUSDS), actualInVault) is ignored. settle returns the credited amount; unchecked. Corroborated by Aderyn.

addLiquidity(params) returns a tuple (amountsIn, bptAmountOut, returnData); only bptAmountOut is captured, amountsIn and returnData discarded. Review whether actual amountsIn (vs requested) must be reconciled.
[V1 context] Return value of IBalancerVault(_vault).unlock(data) ignored. Corroborated by Aderyn.
[V1 context] Return value of IBalancerVault(_vault).addLiquidity(params) ignored. Corroborated by Aderyn.
[V1 context] Return value of IBalancerVault(_vault).settle(IERC20(_primeToken), actualPrimeInVault) ignored. Corroborated by Aderyn.

gemAmt = (usdsAmount * WAD) / (conv * (WAD + tout)) is divided, then usdsSpent = gemAmt * conv * (WAD + tout) / WAD multiplies the quotient (line 257). Pattern appears intentional/documented (floor gemAmt then recompute exact PSM spend, remainder is dust), but precision-loss/rounding direction should be verified against DssLitePsm semantics so the contract never under-approves buyGem.

Strict equality `sUSDSAmount == 0` used to early-return 0. Benign: it is a balance==0 short-circuit on a view/query path, not a manipulable equality gate. Recorded for completeness (arithmetic/equality not auto-dropped).

findings.description: migrate() loops i=1..v1.nextIndex() with external balanceOf/burn per index AND a nested inner loop minting one V2 NFT per unit of balance (v2.mintFor in a j<balance loop). Unbounded by both index count and per-index balance — potential gas-exhaustion / migration DoS for large holders. Corroborated by Aderyn costly-ops-in-loop (line 43) and loop-require (line 53). Worth an interaction-tier look.
